title: flex-grow as a bench vise
label: Bench vise on a swivel pedestal. A ruled px rail carries three blocks, grow 1, grow 2 and grow 0, between the fixed jaw and a moving jaw with a T-handle. A coil follows each grow point.
caption: Free space is shared by grow, 1 + 2 + 0 = 3 shares. The grow 2 block's spring takes twice the grow 1 block's room, and the grow 0 block gets none. Move the pointer across the figure to slide the jaw shut, and both springs shrink in proportion until the blocks touch.
